_readme: Read by RCG_terminal (rcg_version.lua) on start and every few hours. A server whose installed version (fxmanifest.lua) is older than 'latest' prints the newer releases in its console. 'releases' = newest first; severity = important | recommended | optional; 'why' = one line on why it matters.

releases.why: On ESX with envi-bridge every charge went to the worker and none to the company.
